flags: UNREAD: https://www.villageofcarbon.com/attractions/campgrounds/ (and the village home and /attractions/ pages) return HTTP 418 to curl, to the headless browser and to WebFetch; the Wayback capture of 2024-02-11 returned 202 with no body. No operator page was read, so the rate, season, booking channel (the note's 'Camp Reservations Canada') and hookups are unconfirmed. Searches found no Camp Reservations Canada listing for Carbon. A human with a normal browser should read the page's East Campground tab (#tab-id-3).

PHONE (stored empty): 403-572-3244 - Google 'Village of Carbon - East Campground & Cabins' (+1 403-572-3244, 4.2 stars from 88 reviews, 100 East Campground Rd); Travel Drumheller gives the same number for the village campgrounds. Not confirmed on the village's own (unreadable) page.

SECONDARY (Travel Alberta, provincial tourism listing, not written): 'quiet, quaint campground with 36 RV sites, six tent sites and two tenting cabin located on the east side of the Village of Carbon', 'sewer dumping station', 'Wash House with indoor bathrooms and free showers', borders a baseball diamond, 'scenic creek and 3 kilometres of walking trails'; 'Season Availability Spring, Summer, Fall'. It links the village page (#tab-id-3). Campendium (aggregator) lists May-September and a last nightly rate of $38 - not used.
PRICE: no rate read from the operator; local-government campground, so the private price gate does not apply. RV Life stored 5 stars, $$.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - keep): on Esri imagery (0.67 m/px) Kneehill Creek, a channel only about 5 m wide, loops along the south side of the campground; the southern loop's sites sit about 20-35 m from it behind a belt of trees and brush. A creek that size under canopy cannot earn more than creekside, and the stored value is never upgraded - no change recommended.

PIN (51.48341,-113.14516): on the south loop at the west part of the campground; the sites spread about 150 m NE to the pull-in rows by the access road (centre about 51.4839,-113.1442), Google's 51.48417,-113.14363 is 135 m NE - within tolerance, no move.
